instructions: Clone https://github.com/Brooooooklyn/canvas.git and checkout detached commit 6661e25b9520bfc2df1e4c9820717fee5dd304fd; verify git rev-parse HEAD.
Initialize the skia submodule and verify its HEAD is ee20d565acb08dece4a32e3f209cdd41119015ca.

Download only the ten Linux x64 gnu assets listed in canvas-0.1.91-evidence.json from GitHub release skia-ee20d565, verify every SHA-256, and copy them to skia/out/Static using the upstream release-skia-binary.mjs naming convention.

Copy canvas-0.1.91.Cargo.lock into the source checkout and use cargo 1.92.0. The accepted invocation resolved this lock without a literal --locked flag; adding --locked is recommended for future rebuild enforcement.
Use Node 24.14.0, rustc/cargo 1.92.0, cargo-zigbuild 0.23.0, Zig 0.16.0, clang 22.1.6, LLD 22.1.6, NASM 2.15.05, CMake 4.3.4, Ninja 1.13.2, and libc++/libc++abi 22.1.6.
Use the Zig x86_64-linux-gnu.2.28 wrapper for target C dependencies, then the external /usr/bin/clang plus LLD wrapper against the exact Debian glibc 2.28 sysroot for the final link.
Use the ten original exact upstream Skia archives without deduplication and preserve the upstream release profile/default runtime behavior.
Set the exact RUSTFLAGS and PATH prefix recorded in canvas-0.1.91-build-record.json; do not export SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, CFLAGS, or CXXFLAGS.

Run cargo +1.92.0 zigbuild --manifest-path $ROOT/source/Cargo.toml --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.2.28 --release (optionally add the recommended --locked enforcement), copy the resulting cdylib as skia.linux-x64-gnu.node, and verify SHA-256 edcbca8d43db993a9066974c97ca0e87fb179aaee61d5e56561a19ae171b643d.
Run the raw-addon and prepared-package checks recorded in canvas-0.1.91-smoke.json with bundled Node 24.14.0.
rebuild.host_note: The accepted x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu artifact requires at most GLIBC_2.28. Target C dependencies use Zig's glibc 2.28 target; the final external clang/LLD link uses the exact Debian glibc 2.28 sysroot.
rebuild.archive_note: The accepted final4/final5 builds use the original exact upstream Skia archives. Earlier deduplicated experimental archives are not build inputs.
